run_analyze_match_cli: run the analyze_match script with --root to parse experiment logs and print win/loss/tie rates
parse_log_file: parse a train.log file to extract win, loss, and tie counts from the last two lines
average_across_seed: average win/loss/tie results across multiple seed runs and print sorted statistics
parse_from_root: parse all experiment subdirectories under a root path and aggregate their train.log results
review_average_across_seed: review the average_across_seed function to understand how it normalizes and sorts experiment results
